personal.preferred_title: Senior Performance & Capacity Engineer | Forecasting, Telemetry Pipelines & Executive Reporting

summary: Senior Performance and Capacity Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience and deep Citi-scale background in infrastructure telemetry, predictive capacity forecasting, KPI reporting, performance analytics, operational playbooks, and executive-facing insights. Built Python/Pandas/PySpark data pipelines ingesting telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints and transforming it into validated reporting, forecasting, and decision-support datasets. Strong fit for capacity engineering roles requiring large-scale infrastructure analysis, resource optimization, risk mitigation, budgeting support, operational readiness, stakeholder communication, and data-driven forecasting models.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Owned capacity and performance analytics workflows for large-scale banking infrastructure, transforming telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints into executive-ready insights for planning, risk reduction, and resource optimization.
Built Python/Pandas/PySpark pipelines ingesting BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily, AppDynamics, Oracle, and AWS-backed telemetry into curated reporting and forecasting datasets.
Developed ML forecasting workflows using Prophet and scikit-learn to project capacity trends, identify bottleneck risk, and support proactive infrastructure planning.
Designed KPI-based reporting models and dashboards that converted raw utilization, performance, and capacity telemetry into actionable decision-support views for senior stakeholders.
Supported capital planning and resource-allocation decisions by analyzing utilization patterns, underused infrastructure, seasonal demand, growth trends, and provisioning risk.
Created operational runbooks, metric definitions, data flow notes, validation checkpoints, and support procedures to improve repeatability, team onboarding, and knowledge sharing.
Troubleshot production data and reporting issues by tracing source feeds, transformation logic, SQL behavior, failed outputs, latency symptoms, and downstream reporting discrepancies.
Partnered with infrastructure, application, analytics, and business teams to translate capacity and performance signals into practical recommendations for operational stability and service delivery.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Managed Dynatrace AppMon and Gomez Synthetic Monitoring analytics for Brand.com and critical hospitality systems.
Led the FAST project, mining real-user and synthetic performance metrics to identify optimization opportunities and communicate findings to engineering teams.
Built operational dashboards and reporting views that converted raw monitoring data into actionable reliability and performance insights.
Supported AWS cloud migration planning by evaluating monitoring readiness, transaction visibility, and performance reporting needs.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Managed enterprise CA APM telemetry environments with 50+ Enterprise Managers and 4,000–6,000 instrumented agents across large financial-services infrastructure.
Built Perl and KornShell/ksh automation for extracting, transforming, validating, and distributing performance telemetry, replacing manual exports with repeatable reporting workflows.
Established dashboard, alert, SLA threshold, reporting, and technical documentation standards adopted across client environments.
Mentored technical teams and partnered with J2EE, WebLogic, infrastructure, database, and operations groups to analyze telemetry, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and resolve production issues.

experience.title: Performance Test Engineer
bullets: Analyzed enterprise telecom applications under load to identify throughput limits, SQL/JDBC bottlenecks, CPU, memory, thread, and garbage-collection constraints.
Configured JMX Monitoring, Wily Introscope, and thread-dump automation scripts to improve runtime visibility during performance and regression testing.
Documented baseline metrics, regression thresholds, test findings, and release-readiness notes used by engineering teams for production decisions.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Led migration of a high-throughput shopping engine from 200+ MySQL nodes to a 6-node Oracle RAC cluster, preserving transaction performance and data integrity.
Optimized SQL and Oracle access patterns for high-volume workloads while reducing physical hardware footprint by 95%.
Built C++/OCCI/OCI validation and regression testing utilities to verify correctness across millions of migrated transaction records.
Automated schema conversion, data validation, and phased cutover support for a mission-critical enterprise migration.

experience.title: Architect / Developer (IRS CADE Project)
bullets: Designed UML class and sequence diagrams and developed modules for IRS CADE mainframe modernization.
Built CICS, MQ Series, XML messaging interfaces, and DB2-backed components in a government modernization environment.
Supported technical design documentation and integration patterns for structured data exchange across modernization components.

experience.title: Developer / Support Engineer (Billing, Interfaces, CSM/PRMS)
bullets: Developed and supported high-availability C++/Pro*C/PL/SQL billing interfaces and data feed processes for telecom-scale transaction systems.
Built automation scripts in KornShell/ksh, Perl, Awk, Syncsort, and SQL to support data extraction, transformation, reporting, deployments, and operational housekeeping.
Implemented business logic in billing and integration workflows using C/C++, Pro*C, PL/SQL, SQL scripts, XML, shell automation, and enterprise messaging interfaces.
Improved database performance by 10x through SQL, sequence, and process optimization while reducing memory usage by 75%.
